title: Smiling Father Holding Laughing Baby Outdoors, 1955 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A touching outdoor snapshot from July 1955 featuring a beaming father in a tailored suit jacket holding his laughing baby, who is dressed in a cozy hooded knit bonnet, plaid overalls, and booties. They are seated on the brick ledge outside a mid-century residential house, with greenery, another home, and the roof of a 1950s automobile visible in the background. The front lower right corner features an ink date notation '7/55'. The photograph features classic deckled edges.
